posts.title: Zq Fixture Post One
posts.excerpt: Everything you need to know to start your journey — from key terms to tips on what to try first.
posts.body: Cannabis can feel intimidating when you're new to it. This guide walks through the basics — strains, formats, and dosing tips — so you can make informed choices.

posts.title: Zq Fixture Post Two
posts.excerpt: How to be a great host with curated product selections for any occasion.
posts.body: A great host knows how to set the tone. Whether it is a quiet evening with friends or a celebration, the right product picks can elevate the experience.

posts.title: Zq Fixture Post Three
posts.excerpt: Check out the latest products hitting our shelves and coming soon.
posts.body: A fresh wave of products just landed. Here is a quick rundown of what to look for on your next visit.

posts.title: Zq Fixture Post Four
posts.excerpt: Indica, Sativa, Hybrid — what each one means and which might be right for you.
posts.body: Indica, Sativa, Hybrid — the words are everywhere, but what do they actually mean for the experience you are looking for?

posts.title: Zq Fixture Post Five
posts.excerpt: How craft growers and sustainable practices are shaping the industry.
posts.body: Craft growers are leading the way on sustainability. We profile a few of the producers we partner with.

posts.title: Zq Fixture Post Six
posts.excerpt: The aromatic compounds that shape flavor, aroma, and effect.
posts.body: Terpenes are the aromatic compounds responsible for the smell, taste, and a good portion of the perceived effect of a strain.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq One
questions.answer: You can place an order online through our website, by phone, or in-store at any of our locations. Simply browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll receive an order confirmation via email.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Two
questions.answer: We offer three delivery options: In-store pickup (free), local delivery within 15 miles ($5.99), and mail order shipping nationwide (rates vary by location). Local delivery is available same-day for orders placed before 2 PM.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Three
questions.answer: Yes! During checkout, you can select your preferred pickup or delivery date up to 14 days in advance. For custom orders or large quantities, we recommend ordering at least 48 hours ahead.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Four
questions.answer: Orders can be cancelled for a full refund up to 24 hours before the scheduled pickup/delivery time. Custom orders require 48 hours notice for cancellation. Contact us as soon as possible if you need to make changes.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Five
questions.answer: Yes! All our cookies, brownies, and pastries are baked fresh every morning using high-quality ingredients. We never sell day-old products - anything not sold is donated to local food banks.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Six
questions.answer: We offer gluten-free, vegan, and nut-free options at all our locations. Look for the dietary labels on our product pages. Please note that while we take precautions, our kitchen does handle common allergens.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Seven
questions.answer: We use premium ingredients including real butter, pure vanilla extract, Belgian chocolate, and locally-sourced eggs. All our products are free from artificial preservatives and trans fats. Full ingredient lists are available for each product.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Eight
questions.answer: Our cookies stay fresh for 5-7 days when stored in an airtight container at room temperature. Brownies last 3-5 days. Cakes should be refrigerated and consumed within 3-4 days. All products can be frozen for up to 3 months.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Nine
questions.answer: Absolutely! We create custom cakes for birthdays, weddings, corporate events, and any special occasion. Contact us at least 5 days in advance for standard custom cakes, or 2 weeks for elaborate designs.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Ten
questions.answer: Yes, we offer cookie platters in various sizes: Small (2 dozen, serves 10-15), Medium (4 dozen, serves 25-30), and Large (6 dozen, serves 40-50). We can also create custom assortments based on your preferences.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Eleven
questions.answer: Of course! Our talented bakers can create custom designs, add logos, match color schemes, or bring your vision to life. Share your ideas or reference images when placing your order, and we'll work with you to make it perfect.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Twelve
questions.answer: Custom order pricing depends on size, complexity, and design requirements. Basic custom cakes start at $45, while elaborate designs may cost more. We'll provide a quote before you confirm your order. Contact us for a personalized estimate.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Thirteen
questions.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), debit cards, e-transfers, gift cards, and cash (in-store only). Apple Pay and Google Pay are also available for online orders.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Fourteen
questions.answer: Yes! Gift cards are available in any denomination from $10 to $500. They can be purchased online or in-store and never expire. Digital gift cards are delivered instantly via email.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Fifteen
questions.answer: Yes! Join our Sweet Rewards program and earn 1 point for every dollar spent. Earn 100 points and get $10 off your next order. Members also receive exclusive discounts, early access to new products, and a free cookie on their birthday!

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Sixteen
questions.answer: Prices may vary slightly between locations due to regional factors. The prices shown on our website reflect the selected store location. You can change your location to see accurate pricing for your area.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Seventeen
questions.answer: Most locations are open Monday-Saturday 7 AM - 8 PM and Sunday 8 AM - 6 PM. Hours may vary by location and during holidays. Check the Locations page for specific store hours.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Eighteen
questions.answer: Yes! We offer free samples of our featured products at all locations. Ask any of our friendly staff members and they'll be happy to let you try before you buy.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Nineteen
questions.answer: Select locations have cafe seating where you can enjoy your treats with a coffee or tea. Check our Locations page for stores with seating available.

questions.question: Zq Fixture Faq Twenty
questions.answer: Yes! We offer corporate catering for meetings, events, and employee appreciation. We can provide branded packaging, deliver to your office, and set up displays. Contact us for corporate pricing and options.

Payment must be made at the time of purchase using approved payment methods. All sales are final unless otherwise stated in our return policy.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section One
privacy.content: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or make a purchase. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the site.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Two
privacy.content: Our products are intended for adults of legal age only. By using this website, you confirm that you are at least 18 years of age (or the legal age in your jurisdiction). We collect age verification information to comply with applicable laws and regulations governing the sale of cannabis products.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Three
privacy.content:
We may collect information about you in a variety of ways:

  • Personal Data: Name, email address, phone number, mailing address, and payment information when you create an account or make a purchase.
  • Age Verification Data: Date of birth and government-issued identification to verify legal age requirements.
  • Transaction Data: Purchase history, order details, and payment records as required by law.
  • Device Data: IP address, browser type, operating system, and device identifiers for security and analytics purposes.
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent on pages, and navigation patterns to improve our services.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Four
privacy.content:
We use the information we collect to:

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Verify your age and identity as required by law
  • Communicate with you about orders, products, and promotions
  • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
  • Prevent fraud and enhance security
  • Improve our website and customer experience
  • Send marketing communications (with your consent)

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Five
privacy.content: As a licensed cannabis retailer, we are required to maintain certain records and may be required to share information with regulatory authorities. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding the collection, retention, and disclosure of customer information.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Six
privacy.content: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required by law. Transaction records may be retained for the period required by cannabis regulatory authorities.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Seven
privacy.content:
We may share your information with:

  • Service Providers: Third parties who assist with payment processing, delivery, and website operations
  • Regulatory Authorities: Government agencies as required by cannabis regulations
  • Legal Requirements: When required by law, court order, or legal process
  • Business Transfers: In connection with a merger, sale, or acquisition

We do not sell your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Eight
privacy.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience, remember your preferences, and analyze site traffic. You can control cookies through your browser settings, but disabling cookies may limit your ability to use certain features.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Nine
privacy.content:
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your information (subject to legal requirements)
  • Opt out of marketing communications
  • Request a copy of your data in a portable format

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Ten
privacy.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Eleven
privacy.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us at our store locations or through our website contact form.

privacy.title: Zq Fixture Section Twelve
privacy.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be indicated by an updated "Last Updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
